d: An exclusive chart of the 100 biggest rock songs of the 80s, based on streaming data, historic sales info, and enduring global appeal.
An exclusive chart of the 100 biggest rock songs of the 80s, based on streaming data, historic sales info, and enduring global appeal.
Who were the biggest superstar showoffs of the decade? Well how about Sting, Meatloaf, Iggy, Freddie, Geldof, Jagger, Rod and Daltrey for starters? But who's our No.1 rock frontman?
1970-79, Glam, Glitter & a big slice of classic rock! From flamboyant trailblazers to stadium anthems including Bowie, Alice Cooper, T.Rex, Slade, Queen, Suzi Quatro & loads more!
Your weekend anthems and the biggest rock songs from the last 50 years! From the Beatles and the Stones in the 60s right through to One Republic and Kings Of Leon in the 10s.
An hour of the greatest emo tracks the noughties had to offer featuring Linkin Park, Fall Out Boy, Thirty Seconds To Mars and My Chemical Romance.
A definitive selection of rock and indie anthems from the 2010s! Starting with My Chemical Romance in 2010 right through to Liam Gallagher at the end of the decade.
Claire Sturgess has her 30 rock & indie heroes from the 2020s. With legends like Sum 41, Green Day & Biffy Clyro plus new names like YungBlud & Sam Fender but who is her no. 1?
Rock Riffs, indie anthems and a new generation of rock legends from 2000 to now! Expect YungBlud, BMTH, The Arctic Monkeys, Fall Out Boy & loads more!
99 anthems of rock from the noughties! With Green Day, Linkin Park, The Strokes, Paramore, Blink-182, The Killers & much more!
Number 1 rock songs from the last 50 years! With mega hits from the Arctic Monkeys and KOL right back to legends like The Stones and T.Rex!
Remember when rock was WILD? From '64 to '74 the pioneering heroes presented by a man who was at the centre of it all - from The Kinks to The Beatles to Black Sabbath to Queen!
From Peter Frampton & Free to Foreigner & Fleetwood Mac - the 70s was a feelgood & carefree time for pop & rock, and we bring back that vibe with 30 of the absolute best!
Party pop rock anthems spanning 5 decades! From Queen, Kiss and Aerosmith to Blur, Paramore and The White Stripes.
Rounding off the week with rock classics and anthems! We guarantee AC/DC, Nirvana, Queen, Meat Loaf, Bon Jovi & much more!
Starting back in 1974 here is an hour of Anthems from the greatest British rock band in the world!
30 of the biggest, timeless anthems! Featuring legendary acts like Aerosmith, Kiss, and Queen, through to Razorlight, Fall Out Boy and Evanescence.
Rounding off the week with rock classics and anthems! We guarantee AC/DC, Nirvana, Queen, Meat Loaf, Bon Jovi & much more!
25 years of classic rock from an era where the look was nearly as important as the music! From Led Zeppelin in 1970 to Def Leppard in 1995.
Rock ballads from Queen, Bon Jovi, Whitesnake, Meat Loaf, Nickleback and Evanescence.
20 epic songs loaded with mega hair energy & power chords! From 80s rock icons Boston, Whitesnake & Chicago to modern day heroes The Darkness, Green Day & My Chemical Romance.

t: The Wild Ones with Suzi Quatro!
d: Our godmother of Rock, Suzi Quatro is here with the wildest Rock Stars of the 70's! But who is the craziest and most outlandish? Bowie, Meatloaf, Queen or even Suzi herself?
The most iconic and ear-shattering rock songs that shaped the genre! Including Led Zeppelin's timeless Whole Lotta Love and AC/DC´s rebellious Highway to Hell. Crank it up and enjoy!
Rounding off the week with rock classics and anthems! We guarantee AC/DC, Nirvana, Queen, Meat Loaf, Bon Jovi & much more!
Rock & Roll started as a rebellion and Nicky Horne brings you the 25 people who pushed all the boundaries & refused to conform! These are greatest Rock Rebels of all time!
An hour of Anthems and the biggest rock songs from rock legends ACDC.
Time to brutally assault your ears with the heaviest in metal music from the monsters of the 80s scene! Everyone can headbang along to WASP, Anthrax, Metallica and Iron Maiden.
